facts.name: Salvia 'Caradonna'
facts.notes: Upright violet spikes on near-black stems in early summer. Cut it back after the first flush for a second round. Bees love it.

sources.note: Shear perennial salvia, coreopsis, Shasta daisy, columbine, coral bells, hardy geranium and catmint after flowering; many rebloom in 5 to 6 weeks.
